title: Arthur742Ramos/TopologicalComputationalPaths
abstract: A Lean formalization of topological semantics for endpoint-varying computational paths.  It constructs both the canonical final composable quotient and the ordinary pullback of quotient arrows.  The selected result proves that the canonical comparison is a continuous bijection and characterizes exactly when it is quotient, a homeomorphism, and an induced topology agreement; under these equivalent conditions ordinary composition is continuous.  It also records discontinuity as an obstruction and proves compact--Hausdorff and discrete sufficient cases.  The selected certificate additionally requires full additive classifications of the genuine based-loop spaces `AddCircle (1 : ℝ)` by `ℤ` and its product torus by `ℤ × ℤ`: the invariant, identity value, composition additivity, explicit standard representatives, and both inverse laws are checked using covering-map lifts and coordinatewise arguments.  It also formalizes the observable based fiber of the universal continuous-path presentation, its homeomorphism to the standard based loop quotient, the final/ordinary pair comparison, and the source-backed Hawaiian-earring transfer: the non-quotient square and discontinuous multiplication force failure of the scoped ordinary-pair quotient, topology agreement, and ordinary multiplication continuity under the comparison.
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
